name: oat-table-tools
description: Owen's Applied Thinking table promotion commands for VS Code

scripts.test: node test/parseTables.test.js && node test/tableImageWidth.test.js && node test/repairFigures.test.js && node test/parseBlockquotes.test.js

commands.title: OAT Tables: Promote All Tables in Document
OAT Tables: Repair and Renumber Figures
OAT Tables: Promote Selection as Pullquote
OAT Tables: Promote All Pullquotes in Document

oatTables.workerUrl.description: Cloudflare Worker URL for OAT table promotion.

oatTables.imagesRepoPath.description: Absolute path to the local images repo. Defaults to ~/dev/oat-assets.

oatTables.screenshotScriptPath.description: Absolute path to screenshot-html.sh. Defaults to scripts/screenshot-html.sh in this extension if present, then ~/dev/wraith/scripts/screenshot-html.sh.

oatTables.puppeteerDir.description: Directory containing a node_modules/puppeteer install, used by screenshot-html.sh to render table PNGs. Defaults to this extension's dev repo checkout (~/dev/oat-tools/extensions/table-tools).
